checks.name: R19 backup and archive slices preserve all original Unicode text and record boundaries
Unknown contracts stay visible and cannot enter a batch
Repeated IDs refuse both copies rather than choosing by archive order
Invalid records stay visible while independent valid archive entries remain selectable
Malformed nested JSON, duplicate fields, transport damage and unsupported containers fail closed
A nested unpaired UTF-16 surrogate cannot be silently replaced during exact UTF-8 extraction
Limits cover file bytes, archive characters, collection size, batch count and duplicate selection
Experimental replay is individual only and main archives never silently expand their format
An unrelated damaged backup group is disclosed without inventing a restoration or hiding replay validation
Sequential batch reconstructs real current, historical and experimental recordings with unchanged engines
Falsified outcome fails inside a mixed batch while another actual replay still verifies
Cancelling a pending factory settles immediately and cancels its eventual task without stale results
Cancelling an active engine tears it down and never advances to another selected replay

scope: Original R19/R13 validators, original three real engine routes and controlled batch cancellation. No game storage, cloud restoration or physical crash certification.
